'''Jiran VII''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained a monastery, which was also the home of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] monk [[Dao Jodh]].
